bc_reproductive_ageing.definition: The way the reproductive system changes as a person gets older.
bc_reproductive_ageing.example: Reproductive ageing is gradual, and it is not the same for everybody.

benchmark.definition: A figure used to compare your pay with the market rate for the same role.
benchmark.example: The benchmark for this role in Hanoi is around $1,750.

brush_your_teeth.definition: To clean your teeth with a toothbrush and toothpaste, usually for two minutes.
brush_your_teeth.example: I brush my teeth before I put on my pyjamas.

date.definition: A planned meeting with someone you are getting to know. It implies time set aside for each other.
date.example: Is Friday a date, or just a coffee between friends?

mon_currency_union.definition: An arrangement in which several states use one currency and a single authority issues it for all of them.
mon_currency_union.example: The euro area is a currency union, so one central bank issues the notes for every member country.

wh_voltage.definition: The push of electric charge that drives a current.
wh_voltage.example: The voltage across the cell is 12 V.
